name: Delivering Bad News Professionally
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on delivering bad news professionally -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Unfortunately, we won't be able to meet the original deadline.
I wanted to flag a delay before it becomes a bigger issue.
I understand this isn't ideal news -- here's what we're doing to address it.
We're actively working on a solution and will update you by Friday.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
